label: File-based index rebalancing (shard affinity)
type: the index rebalance method that moves index files between nodes rather than rebuilding indexes from the Data Service; an opt-in cluster setting on Couchbase Server and the default on Capella
note: Two files, both quotable, both stating the same restriction: 'You cannot use this property if you have enabled file-based index rebalancing.' - subject of disablesFeatureFor against n1ql:alter-index-with-nodes and n1ql:alter-vector-index-with-nodes. Promoted because that is a real capability interaction and not a cross-reference: enabling a rebalance method takes a DDL property away. THE SAME MECHANISM IS MODELLED TWO WAYS IN THE CORPUS AND THIS RECORD DOES NOT MERGE THEM: the Capella records attribute the identical restriction to deployment:capella ('as it defaults to file-based index rebalancing'), i.e. as a property of the deployment, while on Server it is an opt-in setting a cluster may or may not have enabled. Both readings are faithful to their own page. Filed in index: rather than index-type: because a rebalance method is not a kind of index; sibling of index:index-redistribution-setting, which answers the adjacent question of what happens to indexes on rebalance automatically.
relates_to_competency_question: What happens to my indexes when the cluster rebalances?
